messages:
maria: Quick async standup from me — focusing on kernel microbatch changes + KV cache investigation today.
maria: What I did yesterday: landed the microbatch scheduler prototype on the alpha branch, ran initial 1k req perf sweep, saw ~12% p99 improvement for short-seq workloads.
keith: Nice, saw the CI run. Any regressions on long-context workloads?
maria: Long-context tails look neutral so far, but there’s a small regression in memory for sequences >16k tokens from a temporary KV buffer growth I introduced.
raj: Can you point to the diff? I can take a look at buffer sizing.
maria: PR is at https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/428 — focus is in kernel/scheduler.py. The growth happens when microbatching merges KV queues; adding an early trim seems to fix it but I want feedback on concurrency safety.
sasha: I'll review after standup. Also, did you test with the quantized path? Sometimes kernel changes interact badly with int8 kernels.
maria: I ran a smoke with q8_0 and saw slightly higher CPU spikes, not sure if it's the kernel or the new batching window. Bench-bot: ran perf job #987.
bench-bot: perf summary for job #987: short-seq (<=128 tokens) throughput +18%, p99 latency -12%, long-seq (>8k) throughput -2%, memory spike on Q8 path +6%.
keith: Thanks bench-bot. Blockers: Maria, do you need a quick pairing to debug the KV trim race? I can free up 30m.
maria: Yes please — the race seems to be between the batch flush thread and async cache evict. Repro is flaky locally but consistent on dev-GPU-3.
raj: If it's the evict path, check that we only hold the KV lock for the minimal critical section. There was a similar bug in the previous LRU impl.
sasha: Also ping @infra — dev-GPU-3 was OOMing yesterday, might be noisy.
maria: Will file infra ticket if I can repro reliably. Today: add guard and tests for KV trim, run full perf matrix (q4/q8/fp16) and open a small follow-up to make kernel scheduler disable-able at runtime for canary.
keith: For the canary rollout config, we should add a toggle in runtime/configs/canary.yaml so ops can flip without redeploy. I can draft that.
raj: I can help add unit tests for KV race — will mock the evict thread.
sasha: Reviewers: @keith @raj — please prioritize the PR, it's small but risky for memory.
maria: Thanks. Quick ask: anyone available for a 30m sync at 11:30 PT? I want to repro on dev-GPU-3 with one of you.
keith: I can do 11:30.
raj: on calendar.
sasha: busy until 12:00, skip for me.
maria: ack. Also leaving a snippet that reproduces the mem growth locally:

```bash
# repro script
python tools/repro_kv_growth.py --model llama-13b --seq 16384 --concurrency 4 --microbatch on
```

maria: If you run it, please dump `/tmp/kv-stats.json` and ping the channel.
keith: running now, will share logs.
bench-bot: attached perf artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/job-987/
raj: I'll queue up the unit tests and push later this afternoon.
maria: Thanks all — will update thread with PR link and perf results. :thumbsup:
